room.inn.title: Fellside Inn
room.inn.description: A low inn with a peat fire. A door opens north onto the fell.
room.fell.title: Open Fell
room.fell.description: Bare moor under an open sky. The inn lies south.
room.fell.frost: Bare moor under an open sky. Frost whitens the heather; the cold bites. The inn lies south.
room.fell.heat: Bare moor under an open sky. The sun beats down and nothing gives shade. The inn lies south.
room.fell.rain: Bare moor under an open sky. Rain sheets across the heather. The inn lies south.
room.fell.gale: Bare moor under an open sky. A gale tears at everything. The inn lies south.
item.cloak.room: A [wool cloak] hangs by the door.
item.cloak.description: A heavy cloak of grey wool. It keeps out the cold.
item.hat.room: A [straw hat] sits on a peg.
item.hat.description: A wide straw hat. It keeps off the sun.
item.oilskin.room: An [oilskin coat] drips on a hook.
item.oilskin.description: A waxed coat. It keeps out the rain.
item.scarf.room: A [thick scarf] lies on the bench.
item.scarf.description: A long knitted scarf. It keeps out the wind.
narration.chilled.applied: The frost bites through your clothes.
narration.chilled.tick: You shiver; the cold saps your strength.
narration.chilled.expired: Warmth creeps back into your limbs.
narration.overheated.applied: The sun beats on your bare head.
narration.soaked.applied: Rain soaks you to the skin.
